text:
Maya: quick sync — dropping the new sidebar regrouping mock here. goal: improve scent/scannability when folks jump straight to a model or route. thoughts?

Tom: looked — the 3-group pattern (Workspaces / Models / Operations) feels cleaner. curious about how bread crumbs should label workspace vs project. we need consistent copy.

Alex: +1 on groups. proposal: breadcrumbs show Workspace > Project > Page. e.g. `Acme Corp > Payments > Models`. keep workspace first for external links.

Sam: implementation note: if we change URL path shape we break a handful of marketplace links. we should preserve a stable permalink contract — prefer query params for ephemeral UI state.

Maya: agree on stable permalinks. suggested URL shape in the prototype:
```
/workspaces/:wid/projects/:pid/models/:modelId
/workspaces/:wid/projects/:pid?panel=usage#metrics
```

use `panel` query param to keep route stable while preserving open panes.

Nina: accessibility nits: when sidebar regroup happens, ensure `aria-current` on active link and a visually hidden label that reads the full breadcrumb path. keyboard focus must land in content area when navigating deep links.

Tom: small UX thought — when a deeplink lands to a nested modal (eg. edit prompt), we should fallback to the parent model page and open the modal. fallback policy: modal -> parent route, not root. reduces orphaned contexts.

Alex: routing edgecases: bookmarked links with old query params should redirect 301 at the router level. we can add a migration map in frontend router to maintain SEO/permalink hygiene.

Maya: copy tweak idea: in sidebar group header use sentence-case nouns: "Workspaces", "Models", "Operations" (not verbs). short, consistent.

Sam: test ops — add E2E that navigates via keyboard to a deeplink, asserts aria-current, and verifies focus trap leaves to content. also add telemetry event on deep-link landing (route, referrer) so we can see common entry points.

aria-bot: reminder: design review items logged -> https://tickets/redwood/NR-428 (regrouping) and NR-429 (breadcrumbs & routing).

Nina: question: do we want the breadcrumb to be clickable at every level on narrow screens? mobile behavior should collapse to a single title with a chevron that opens full path.

Maya: yes — mobile: single-line breadcrumb, tap opens overlay with full path. desktop: full clickable trail. we'll add a small prototype for mobile overlay.

Tom: implementation constraint — continuous batching UI depends on a top-level models route to request metrics. if we move models into nested group must ensure metrics route remains at `/models/:id/metrics` or provide alias.

Maya: decision proposal for today:
- Keep canonical resource path pattern (no hashes for primary resource).
- Use query param `panel=` for ephemeral state like panes/modals.
- Fallbacks: modal deeplink -> parent route open modal.
- Add router alias map for backwards compatibility.

Alex: +1. can we A/B the new grouping for 2 weeks? small sample for power users then expand.

Maya: sounds good. action items:
- Maya: finalise mock + copy updates (by EOD).
- Sam: add router alias plan + E2E tests (tomorrow).
- Tom: scope telemetry for deep-link landing (this week).
- Nina: accessibility checklist and keyboard prototype (next week).

Sam: noted. I'll open a PR for the alias map once we confirm canonical patterns.

Nina: tiny copy nudge: breadcrumb separator should be `›` not `/` — clearer for screen readers.

Maya: adding to notes. thanks all :thumbsup:

Tom: :eyes: will follow up on the modal fallback UX with a quick screen recording.

Maya: closing the sync — I'll post the final mocks in the thread when ready.
